title: Design of a Cyclic Pressure Bioreactor for the Ex Vivo Study of Aortic Heart Valves
protocol: Collect adult pig aortic valves immediately after death, ensuring the pigs weigh no more than 120 lbs.
Wash the collected aortic valves twice with sterile phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Transport the washed valves on ice to the laboratory.
Perform all subsequent steps under sterile conditions.
Remove leaflets from the aortic root by cutting 1/3 of the distance from the annulus, ensuring no signs of degeneration, tearing or calcification are present.
Place the isolated leaflets in individual wells of a six-well plate.
Incubate overnight with 3 ml Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium supplemented with 1% antibiotic/antimycotic solution and 10% fetal bovine serum at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Log on to the computer and open the labVIEW program for pressure studies.
Connect the power supply to the circuit board to provide power to the solenoid valves controlling air flow into and out of the chamber.
Ensure the compressed air is connected to the system and open the air supply to full velocity.
Turn on the signal amplifier.
Adjust the voltage reading to 0.00 if necessary.
Set the labVIEW interface switch to "TEST".
Click the button marked "Air Supply" to open the inlet solenoid valve.
Pressurize the chamber with compressed air at 1 PSI using the gas pressure regulator.
Record the voltage reading from the signal amplifier once the pressure has equilibrated.
Repeat for 2, 3, 4, and 5 PSI.
Construct a calibration curve of pressure vs. voltage.
Convert pressure readings from PSI to mmHg.
Spray the chamber with 70% ethanol.
Allow residual ethanol fumes to dissipate for at least 10 minutes.
Place the six-well plate containing the leaflet samples into the chamber.
Replace the aluminum front plate and ensure airtight seal by tightening nuts located on each corner.
Place the pressure chamber in the 37°C incubator.
Set the system cycle time between compressed air input and output to 0.6s and 0.4s, respectively.
Enter the data file path in the interface.
Click run and switch the "TEST/RECORD" toggle to "RECORD" in LabVIEW.
Adjust pressure using the gas pressure regulator to reach desired level.
Run program for desired length of time.
Click stop button on LabVIEW when experiment is complete.
Turn off air supply after stopping the program.
Open exhaust valve on the pressure chamber.
Remove front end plate from the chamber.
Retrieve six-well plate containing samples.
Analyze samples for gene expression, protein expression, histology, mechanical properties, etc.
